observations.fact: The 5120D fused BN and class head are newly initialized with seed+30000; fused_classifier uses weights_init_classifier.
Original DeMo teacher state overwrites matching original keys; newly added keys match NEW_MODULES. No original teacher fused_classifier key is loaded into the new fused head.
fused_neck and fused_classifier are explicitly included among new modules.
ViT-B-16 uses feat_dim512, classifier_moe covers3584D; DIRECT=0 has separate class heads and BN for R/N/T512 each.
Original MoE/shared and R/N/T scores remain full-view auxiliary supervision; fused classification is a separate new head.
Both weak dataset configs use DIRECT0, while the protected RGBNT201 config uses DIRECT1.

implications: Freezing the five identity encoding modules preserves the base representation, but does not make the new final classification head a pretrained head. A later controlled head-initialization or warmup comparison would retain the retrieval graph and parameter shapes; whether it is worth running depends on the actual pending full-primary gradient diagnosis.
limits: Local code observation only; no new model construction, tensor/weight inspection, classifier score measurement, training or performance result. Current fused features are globally normalized before BN; old auxiliary heads receive original raw blocks. Merely concatenating old weights/stats is not proven equivalent to teacher logits and must not be treated as a ready solution. No initializer or head was changed; pending jobs and source bindings remain unchanged.
